title: Project Updates and Meeting Efficiency
discussion_points: Sarah reported that the wireframe for the new onboard flow is complete but needs revisions based on feedback from the design team.
Anas confirmed that the back end team can start setting up API endpoints in parallel with the wireframe revisions.
Omar proposed an AI solution to automate meeting minutes and action item tracking.
The Q3 budget review is scheduled for next Monday, with department estimates due by Friday.
decisions: Sarah will revise the wireframe and deliver it to the developers by Thursday.
Anas's team will start setting up the back end API endpoints.
Omar will develop a proof of concept for the meeting intelligence agent within two weeks.
Azure resources will be provisioned for Omar by tomorrow.
Anas will grant Omar access to the SharePoint templates library.
All departments must submit their Q3 budget estimates by Friday.
